spiritgiven.comments: They were very receptive to calls and heed our opinion.

The spirit captain was participating in all the calls not allowing the players involved to discuss and get to a agreement, he was constantly trying to convince the player of his perspective. The line was complaining about the calls done infield.
If one of the players of their team does not require a translator, it is not necessary for that person to come in.
Some of the calls took advantage of the situation. They doubled teamed the entire game and didn’t correct after many feedbacks on the captains.

Great game, obviously the wind didn’t allow us to play the way we wanted, however the game was good spirited. Communication and receptiveness was very good. They maintained their good attitude throughout the entire game despite the score.

Their communication was very good, they were always willing to receive, listen and were really polite on explaining their perspective. 
There was a lot of contact, specially when handlers tried to go for the crash. There were many foul calls on the disc mark and this was not corrected after the feedback. 
Some Defense bids were late ending up on bumping or collisions. 
Great and windy game!
The coach corrected his players in the regulations but after when it was necessary. For this reason they stopped the game a lot with calls that were not correct.

This game was great, very intense and we enjoyed it a lot. It terms of spirits we think we communicated properly and were able to solve calls appropriately. In the most tight part of the game, some player were having a non-positive attitude (out of the general terms). Remember to call fouls at the moment they happen and not after :)

Great game to finish the tournament. Really good spirit, they communicated very politely always willing to listen and were very receptive. They were cheering for us when wee did something good. Men were a little physical on the body check which could improve :) 
Overall an excellent game!

spiritreceived.comments: Great communication and loved how both teams keep the calls within the time limit.

Rules - Constantly called the same foul, even though it was already clarified (e.g. legal mark, pivoting into mark) This was consistent even after half time. At times, mentioned “did we get an advantage” even though it wasn’t that issue. E.g. establishing where to start the disc.

We felt the picks were too consistant on the field and not recognised as such. We also did not feel heard during calls, as well as the game advisors' interventions. It was still a very intense game, thanks a lot for that !

We felt that the attitude on calls was confrontational, with players unwilling to listen to discussion. Some of our calls on disc space were not respected and body contact was egregious. The discussion of the rules was used to benefit Colombia in almost every situation with little consideration for fairness and spirit of the game.

Thank you for the game! What a windy one!

For fair mindedness, we thought that sometimes your sideline would help bring the disc back but not to where it went out.

For rules knowledge and use, your player was very sure and forceful in saying that they are allowed to kick the cone away but that wasn't the case. We appreciated that it didn't happen again after our communication (: best of luck to you!

Fair mindedness: when calls were made on the field, your player always listening to our perspectives and retracted some calls after.
We had many communications both on or off the field, which made the game better.

There where several situations where you fully trusted our opinions and showed outstanding fair mindedness, despite the score. The conversations at calls were calm and respectful and came to a conclusion quickly. Very friendly conversations on the sideline, congratulating us for plays.
Thank you for a fun and well spirited game
